blocks.content: Course: Rapid Build With Claude Code

Once the Framer wireframes were done, I used them in a specific way: I described each screen's layout in my Claude Code prompt in plain English, referencing the component names and visual structure I had established in Framer.

For example, the Chunk 2b prompt for the landing page described the hero section as: "full-width section with centered headline, subheadline, two CTAs, and a mockup screenshot of the dashboard below the fold." That came directly from the Framer layout.

This is the bridge between design and code: your Claude Code prompt is a written description of what you already drew in the design tool. If the design is clear, the prompt is easy to write. If the design is vague, the prompt will be vague too.
